name: The escalation ladder
title: The escalation ladder
story: Seven rungs appear from the bottom up, each lit as it is reached: a session on the cheap model; a nudge into the live session; a check-in where the stronger model answers go on, guidance or a handover; the stronger model takes over in the same session; a new session from the pushed work and a handover note; the caps (three sessions per card, two hours of agent time, twelve check-in calls, a budget floor); and at the top a person in Needs you, who chooses Grant one session, Leave it waiting or End the card.
